pages.title: Solar Statite
pages.text: A light sail balanced exactly between a star's gravity and its radiation pressure, so it hovers in place without orbiting. It is mostly metamaterial, thin as a breath and much larger than it looks when folded. Unfolded indoors, it drifts toward the nearest lamp.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Dyson swarm needs collectors that can stay put. In the Casimir Vacuum Press I backed a Metamaterial Sheet with a sliver of neutronium so the light pushing it outward balanced the pull of the star.
Made in $(item)Casimir Vacuum Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dyson Swarm Satellite.
